scheme_name: Financial Assistance (Kanyadaan) on the Occasion of Marriage of Daughter- Haryana Silicosis Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be employed in a factory or at a construction site
The worker must be suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana
The worker must be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board
Assistance is available for the marriage of up to three daughters only
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 per worker for the marriage of up to three daughters.
documents_required: certificate of being the widow/widower or nominee (if applicable)
